spec_match.rationale: Probes the spec algorithm line by line: undefined-separator comma, ToString(separator), null/undefined elements to '', empty iterator, one-shot consumption, non-object receiver TypeError.

interactive.rationale: One button, six real probes into a results table.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Feature-index blurb matches the page's actual behavior.

edge_cases.rationale: This is the edge-case concept; every probe is a real call and the receiver probe throws honestly when the method is absent.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5095183554314240 and the exact spec/proposal sections.

conformance.rationale: Each probe has a matching suite assertion; the receiver-throws assertion is existence-guarded so an absent API fails rather than false-passes.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 via CDP: probes run; each row showed the genuine absent-API TypeError under the honest banner; console/network clean; both classes screenshotted.

telemetry_health.rationale: Probe and run asserts carry supported flag and outcomes.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; thrown states pair accent-rose with plain-text error strings on bg-paper.

accessibility.rationale: Buttons 44px; outcome table has scoped headers; a role=status aria-live summary announces probe-run completion (Codex review round 1).

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: CDP matrix: overflow 0 at 360x740 DPR3 and 1280x800 on every page; long monospace results wrap with overflow-wrap. Harness responsive-check confirms ok on both classes after the same-origin failure-scoping fix (Codex review round 1).

openQuestions.title: Verify the success-path results on Chrome 153+
openQuestions.detail: This runner is Chromium 141 without Iterator.prototype.join, so only the honest-failure paths (and the workaround rows, which run fully) could be observed live. Expected success values are transcribed from the Stage 3 spec algorithm; re-run the page and suite on Chrome 153+ (or --js-flags=--js-iterator-join on 152) to confirm.

guidanceConsulted.query: code comparison table run button iterator string building accessible results
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Real controls, status/table semantics, text-duplicated error states.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: labelled select/inputs, 44px buttons, tables with scoped headers and aria-labels, thrown states shown as text with the rose colour only as a secondary cue.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: npx modern-web-guidance@latest search run 2026-08-09; no iterator-join-specific guide exists, general control guidance applied.

summary: Verified with headless Chromium 141 via CDP: every control driven; new-method calls fail with the real TypeError (no simulation) under an honest banner with the exact --js-flags name; the workaround comparisons run fully on this engine; console/network clean; both viewport classes inspected.
